However, they also removed QA orders which are flagged as not real orders. The contract didn't mention removing QA orders, but the data dictionary says they are not real orders, so excluding them is appropriate to answer the estimand for real completed orders. They also claim they removed 6 QA orders; that is supported by second code output. So the evidence list includes a wrong line. So grounding issue.

3. OVERREACH: No causal claim, just descriptive mean. No overreach.

4. UNACKNOWLEDGED DATA PROBLEMS: They noted -1 sentinel but didn't handle missing ages (not needed). They filtered completed orders but didn't exclude refunded orders? They filtered status == 'completed', so refunded excluded. Good. They didn't address the 108 sentinel ages, but not needed. So no unacknowledged problem.

Thus verdict: revise due to grounding issue (incorrect evidence). Also maybe note that they didn't address the fact that revenue string may have commas; they did. So only issue is evidence misstatement.
